reviews.title: Editors’ Choice
reviews.review: Rather than yanking you from your slumber like an alarm clock, this app analyzes your sleep patterns using your device’s microphone, then picks your lightest sleep to rouse you gently.

reviews.title: The way of the world…
reviews.review: I have loved this app for quite some time. I love the wake-up window that helps me ease out of sleep at just the right time, instead of a regular alarm going off in the deepest part of my sleep and leaving me groggy. There is a traditional alarm function and a “no alarm” function as well, which is nice. reviews.title: Shady
reviews.review: Pretty shady business model. I paid for the “early adopter lifetime access” back when this app was getting off the ground. I thought it looked promising and had some good and promising features so I decided to take the risk and make the one-time purchase. I stopped using the app for quite awhile but really needed a sleep app again as I got older. I came back to this app and was initially excited to see the app appeared more polished and restored my lifetime access only to find that it is bogus.

reviews.title: Money Hungry!
reviews.review: I’ve been finding it increasingly frustrating to discover an app that doesn’t immediately require a payment or subscription just to access its basic features. It feels like every app I try either locks essential tools behind a paywall or doesn’t even allow me to explore the interface without committing to a trial or purchase.
